description: CDW CIS L1 baseline SharePoint Online and OneDrive tenant-level settings (Graph subset only). Disables legacy auth, sets idle session sign-out, blocks unmanaged device sync, restricts comments and notifications. Covers parts of CIS 7.2.1, CIS 7.3.2, parts of CIS 1.3.2. NOTE: Most CIS 7.x SharePoint checks (sharingCapability, defaultSharingLinkType, requireAcceptingAccountMatchInvitedAccount, externalUserExpirationRequired, etc.) are NOT exposed via Graph and require Set-SPOTenant PowerShell. This file covers ONLY what Graph supports today.
